data.description:
## Context

PR-G (Week 3 audit remediation) updated `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-envelope.md` to honestly document the current state: the contract claimed `fix-bug Phase B` and `sprint Phase H` parsed `INFERENCE_CHALLENGE` and `INFERENCE_SKIP`, but a grep against both skill files returns zero references. The only emitter is `plugins/dso/agents/red-team-reviewer.md`, which emits JSON objects in its structured report.

So the signal is emitted but never consumed. The "always-challenge" tier in red-team-reviewer.md is therefore advisory text only — the orchestrator does not halt on inferences flagged for user confirmation.

## Decision needed

Wire an orchestrator-level parser that, on receiving a sub-agent report containing `output_type=="INFERENCE_CHALLENGE"`:
1. Halts the calling flow
2. Surfaces the `evidence_against_inference` text to the user
3. Requires explicit user approval before allowing the calling flow to proceed
4. Logs `INFERENCE_SKIP` records to a session ledger for dedup

Open design questions:
- Where in the orchestrator does the parser live (sprint Phase 18 area? a shared post-dispatch hook?)
- Is the halt blocking or advisory?
- Where is the session-level inference ledger persisted (artifacts dir? ticket comment trail?)

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: A red-team-reviewer dispatch that emits INFERENCE_CHALLENGE causes the orchestrator to surface the challenge to the user before any downstream step proceeds.
- AC2: `inference-envelope.md` Consumers table is updated to name the actual parser (replacing the "Future orchestrator parser (planned)" entry).
data.title: Wire INFERENCE_CHALLENGE parser into orchestrator
